0022600027.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers host the Philadelphia 76ers in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup, the Cavaliers' ninth game of the 2026-27 season. Cleveland is 4-3 overall, 3-1 at home, and on a one-game losing streak, sitting 2nd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and 5th in the East. Philadelphia comes in 8-1 on a five-game winning streak, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, and 4-0 on the road; the Cavaliers are without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), while the 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), with Adem Bona day-to-day with a head injury and a game-time decision. The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning 114-106 in Philadelphia on October 22, though the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 series 4-0.
